label: Completion/Reason for Non-Completion
definition: The status of the subject's completion of the study or a segment of the study, or the reason the subject discontinued the study or segment of the study. [extensible=Yes]

label: Study Subject Withdrawal by Parent or Guardian
definition: An indication that a study participant has been removed from the study or from one or more epochs of the study by the parent or legal guardian.

label: Failure to Meet Randomization Criteria
definition: An indication that the subject has been unable to fulfill/satisfy the criteria required for assignment into a randomized group.

label: Trial Site Terminated by Sponsor
definition: An indication that a clinical study was stopped at a particular site by its sponsor. (NCI)

label: Failure To Meet Continuation Criteria
definition: An indication that the subject has not been able to meet protocol-defined continuation criteria and will not continue to participate in the clinical trial.

label: Randomized By Mistake
definition: An indication that the subject was randomized but should not have been.

notation: RANDOMIZED BY MISTAKE WITH STUDY TREATMENT
label: Randomized By Mistake With Study Treatment
definition: An indication that the subject was randomized but should not have been and study treatment was received in error.

notation: RANDOMIZED BY MISTAKE WITHOUT STUDY TREATMENT
label: Randomized By Mistake Without Study Treatment
definition: An indication that the subject was randomized but should not have been however no study treatment was received.

label: Non-Compliance With Non-Study Device
definition: An indication that a subject has not followed the instructions related to a device that is not under study.

label: Non-Compliance With Study Device
definition: An indication that a subject has not followed the instructions related to a device under study.

label: Protocol Violation
definition: A significant departure from processes or procedures that were required by the protocol. Violations often result in data that are not deemed evaluable for a per-protocol analysis, and may require that the subject(s) who violate the protocol be discontinued from the study. Compare to protocol deviation. (CDISC Glossary)

label: Protocol-Specified Withdrawal Criterion Met
definition: An indication that the patient has met one or multiple protocol-specified withdrawal criteria and has been removed from the study or from one or more epochs of the study.

notation: MET ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA BUT NOT NEEDED
label: Subject Met Eligibility Criteria But Was Not Needed
definition: An indication that the subject met inclusion/exclusion criteria but was not needed in the trial.

label: No Longer Clinically Benefiting
definition: An indication that a treatment or therapy was changed or discontinued because it is no longer clinically beneficial to the subject or patient, based on the primary therapeutic objective for which it is being administered and assessed. (Trial Design and Objectives for Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer: Updated Recommendations From the Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials Working Group 3. Scher HI, Morris MJ, Stadler WM, et al.; Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials Working Group 3. J Clin Oncol. 2016 Apr 20;34(12):1402-18.)

label: Subject Removed at Sponsor Request
definition: An indication that the study subject was removed from the study or from one or more epochs of the study at the sponsor's request.

label: Non-Compliance With Study Schedule
definition: An indication that a subject has not followed the schedule of study activities.

label: Screening Not Completed
definition: An indication that the subject did not complete the screening process.

label: Never Dosed
definition: An indication that a subject has not ever been dosed with the study treatment or investigational product.

label: Approved Drug Available For Indication
definition: An indication that an approved drug is available for use for the disease indication.

label: Study Consent Withdrawn
definition: An indication that the consent to participate in the study, or one or more epochs of the study, has been revoked.

label: Logistical Problem With Clinical Study
definition: A problem with some logistical aspect of a clinical study, either on the part of the participant or the site.

label: Requires Prohibited Medication
definition: An indication that the study subject needs to be treated with a medication that is prohibited per the protocol.

label: Partner Pregnancy
definition: An indication that the study subject's partner is pregnant.

label: Pregnant Subject
definition: An indication that the subject is pregnant.

label: Withdrawal of Assent
definition: An indication that the assent to participate in the study, or one or more epochs of the study, has been revoked.

label: Subject Noncompliance
definition: Failure of a study subject to comply with an aspect of the study.

label: Used Prohibited Medication Indicator
definition: An indication that the study subject used a medication that is prohibited per the protocol.

label: Investigator Decision
definition: A position, opinion or judgment reached after consideration by the study investigator, as pertains to the subject.

label: Requires Prohibited Procedure
definition: An indication that the study subject needs to be treated with a procedure that is prohibited per the protocol.

label: Underwent Prohibited Procedure
definition: An indication that the study subject underwent a procedure that is prohibited per the protocol.

notation: MET ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA BUT NOT ENROLLED
label: Met Eligibility Criteria but Not Enrolled
definition: An indication that the subject met inclusion/exclusion criteria but was not enrolled in the study.

label: Complete
definition: To possess every necessary or normal part or component or step; having come or been brought to a conclusion. (NCI)

label: Recovery
definition: A healing process and/or an outcome implying relative health. The term is typically used in the context of direct and indirect effects of sickness or injury. (NCI)

label: Dead
definition: The absence of life or state of being dead. (NCI)

label: Progressive Disease
definition: A disease process that is increasing in extent or severity. (NCI)

label: Recurrent Disease
definition: The return of a disease after a period of remission.

label: Adverse Event
definition: Any untoward medical occurrence in a patient or clinical investigation subject administered a pharmaceutical product and which does not necessarily have a causal relationship with this treatment. An adverse event (AE) can therefore be any unintended sign (including an abnormal laboratory finding), symptom, or disease temporally associated with the use of a medicinal (investigational) product, whether or not related to the medicinal (investigational) product. (CDISC Glossary)

label: Serious Adverse Event
definition: Adverse event that: results in death, is life-threatening, requires inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization, results in persistent or significant disability/ incapacity, or is a congenital anomaly/ birth defect. NOTE: For further information, see the ICH Guideline for Clinical safety Data Management: Definitions and standards for expedited Reporting. [After ICH E2A, ICH E2B]

label: Lack of Efficacy
definition: The lack of expected or desired effect related to a therapy. (NCI)

label: Lost To Follow-Up
definition: The loss or lack of continuation of a subject to follow-up.

label: Physician Decision
definition: A position, opinion or judgment reached after consideration by a physician with reference to subject. (NCI)

label: Trial Screen Failure
definition: The potential subject who does not meet eligibility (inclusion/exclusion) criteria during the screening period.

label: Non-Compliance With Study Drug
definition: An indication that a subject has not agreed with or followed the instructions related to the study medication. (NCI)

label: Study Terminated By Sponsor
definition: An indication that a clinical study was stopped by its sponsor. (NCI)

label: Technical Problem
definition: A problem with some technical aspect of a clinical study, usually related to an instrument. (NCI)

label: Withdrawal by Subject
definition: The subject-initiated act of discontinuing participation in the study as a whole or one or more epochs of the study.

label: Protocol Deviation
definition: A variation from processes or procedures defined in a protocol. Deviations usually do not preclude the overall evaluability of subject data for either efficacy or safety, and are often acknowledged and accepted in advance by the sponsor. NOTE: Good clinical practice recommends that deviations be summarized by site and by category as part of the report of study results so that the possible importance of the deviations to the findings of the study can be assessed. Compare to protocol violation. [See ICH E3] (CDISC Glossary)

label: Route of Administration Response
definition: A terminology codelist relevant to the pathway by which a substance is administered in order to reach the site of action in the body. [extensible=Yes]

label: Oral Route of Administration
definition: Administration to or by way of the mouth. (FDA)

label: Subcutaneous Route of Administration
definition: Administration beneath the skin; hypodermic. Synonymous with the term SUBDERMAL. (FDA)

label: Sex
definition: A terminology codelist relevant to the assemblage of physical properties or qualities by which male is distinguished from female; the physical difference between male and female; the distinguishing peculiarity of male or female. [extensible=No]

label: Female
definition: A person who belongs to the sex that normally produces ova. The term is used to indicate biological sex distinctions, or cultural gender role distinctions, or both. [The NCI Thesaurus contains biomedical terminologies that NCI does not own or control. This concept contains gender-related content that does not comply with Executive Order 14168.]

label: Unknown
definition: Not known, not observed, not recorded, or refused. (NCI)

label: Male
definition: A person who belongs to the sex that normally produces sperm. The term is used to indicate biological sex distinctions, cultural gender role distinctions, or both. [The NCI Thesaurus contains biomedical terminologies that NCI does not own or control. This concept contains gender-related content that does not comply with Executive Order 14168.]

label: Intersex
definition: A person (one of unisexual specimens) who is born with genitalia and/or secondary sexual characteristics of indeterminate sex, or which combine features of both sexes. (NCI)

label: Vital Signs Test Code
definition: The test code given to the test that analyzes a particular set of vital signs including temperature, respiratory rate, heart rate, and blood pressure. [extensible=Yes]

label: Waist Circumference
definition: The distance around an individual's midsection or waist.

label: Body Mass Index
definition: A general indicator of the body fat an individual is carrying based upon the ratio of weight to height. (NCI)

label: Weight
definition: The vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity. (NCI)

label: Systolic Blood Pressure
definition: The maximum blood pressure in the systemic arterial circulation during the cardiac cycle.

label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
definition: The minimum blood pressure in the systemic arterial circulation during the cardiac cycle.

label: Height
definition: The vertical measurement or distance from the base to the top of an object; the vertical dimension of extension. (NCI)

label: Pulse Rate
definition: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot. (NCI)

label: No Yes Response
definition: A term that is used to indicate a question with permissible values of yes/no/unknown/not applicable. [extensible=No]

label: Unknown
definition: Not known, not observed, not recorded, or refused. (NCI)

label: Not Applicable
definition: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context. (NCI)

label: No
definition: The non-affirmative response to a question. (NCI)

label: Yes
definition: The affirmative response to a question. (NCI)

label: Units for Vital Signs Results
definition: The unit used to record and describe the result of a test investigating a vital sign. (NCI) [extensible=Yes]

label: Metabolic Equivalent of Task Unit
definition: A unit of energy expenditure equal to the ratio of metabolic rate during physical activity versus a reference metabolic rate.

label: Kilocalorie per Day
definition: A unit of energy equal to one kilocalorie per day. (NCI)

label: Centimeters of Mercury
definition: A unit of pressure equal to 0.001316 atmosphere and equal to the pressure indicated by one centimeter rise of mercury in a barometer at the Earth's surface.

label: Percentage
definition: One hundred times the quotient of one quantity divided by another, with the same units of measurement.

label: Millimeter
definition: A unit of measure equal to one thousandth of a meter. (NCI)

label: Kilogram
definition: The base unit of mass in the International System of Units (SI) equal to the mass of the international prototype kilogram, a platinum-iridium cylinder in the custody of the International Bureau of Weights and Measures.

label: Meter
definition: A meter is defined as the length of the path traveled by light in a vacuum during a time interval of 1/299 792 458 of a second and is equal to 1.093 61 yards.(NCI)

label: Millisecond
definition: A unit of time, which is equal to one thousandth of a second.(NCI)

label: Second
definition: The base unit of time in the International System of Units (SI) equal to the duration of 9,192,631,770 periods of the specified light radiation corresponding to the transition between the two hyperfine levels of the cesium 133 atom in its ground state at 0 K.

label: Kelvin
definition: A basic unit of thermodynamic temperature, one of the seven base units of the International System of Units (Systeme International d'Unites, SI). It is 1/273.16th of the thermodynamic temperature of the triple point of water. This sets the size of the kelvin unit for temperature differences and defines the thermodynamic temperature of an equilibrium mixture of waters ice-liquid-vapor as 273.16 K, where 0 K is the lowest possible temperature ("absolute zero").

label: Hertz
definition: A unit of frequency equal to one cycle per second.(NCI)

label: Pascal
definition: A unit of pressure equivalent to one Newton per square meter or 10 bars or to 1.45x10(E-4) pounds per square inch.(NCI)

label: Watt
definition: A unit of power equal to the power which in one second produces or transfers the energy of one joule. The unit is used in measurements of power emitted, transferred or received as radiation, sound waves, heat flow rate, and rate of energy transfer. Equal to 1/746 of horsepower.(NCI)

label: Degree Celsius
definition: A unit of temperature of the temperature scale designed so that the freezing point of water is 0 degrees and the boiling point is 100 degrees at standard atmospheric pressure. The current official definition of the Celsius sets 0.01 C to be at the triple point of water and a degree to be 1/273.16 of the difference in temperature between the triple point of water and absolute zero. One degree Celsius represents the same temperature difference as one Kelvin. (NCI)

label: Square Meter
definition: The standard derived unit of area in the International System of Units (SI) equal to the area of a square whose sides are one meter long.

label: Ratio
definition: The quotient of one quantity divided by another, with the same units of measurement.

label: Degree Fahrenheit
definition: The Fahrenheit temperature scale is named after the German physicist Gabriel Fahrenheit (1686-1736), who proposed it in 1724. In this scale, the freezing point of water is 32 degrees Fahrenheit and the boiling point is 212 degrees, placing the boiling and melting points of water 180 degrees apart. In this scale a degree Fahrenheit is 5/9ths of a Kelvin (or of a degree Celsius), and minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit is equal to minus 40 degrees Celsius. (NCI)

label: Gram
definition: A unit of mass equal to one thousandth (1E-3) of a kilogram, the kilogram being the base unit of mass in the International System of Units (SI).

label: Inch
definition: A traditional unit of length equal to 2.54 centimeters. (NCI)

label: Liter
definition: A unit of volume equal to one thousandth (1E-3) of a cubic meter, the cubic meter being the standard derived unit of volume in the International System of Units (SI).

label: Ounce
definition: A unit of mass, the avoirdupois ounce is equal to 1/16 pound, or 28.3495 grams, or 0.911 457 troy ounce.(NCI)

label: Pound
definition: A traditional unit of mass. By international agreement, one avoirdupois pound is equal to exactly 0.453 592 37 kilogram, 16 ounces, or 1.215 28 troy pounds. (NCI)

label: Centimeter
definition: A basic unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter or approximately 0.393700787 inch.

label: Millimeter of Mercury
definition: A unit of pressure equal to 0.001316 atmosphere and equal to the pressure indicated by one millimeter rise of mercury in a barometer at the Earth's surface. (NCI)

label: Kilogram per Square Meter
definition: A unit expressed as kilogram of mass per square meter of area.(NCI)

label: Beats per Minute
definition: The number of heartbeats measured per minute time. (NCI)

label: Breaths per Minute
definition: The number of breaths (inhalation and exhalation) taken per minute time. (NCI)

label: Deciliter
definition: The unit of volume equal to one tenth of a liter. Accepted for use with the SI. (NCI)

label: International Foot
definition: A unit of length defined by the U.S. National Bureau of Standards as 30.48 centimeters. It is equal to 0.3048 meter, 12 inches, or to approximately 0.999998 survey foot.(NCI)

label: Vital Signs Test Name
definition: The test name given to the test that analyzes a particular set of vital signs including temperature, respiratory rate, heart rate, and blood pressure. [extensible=Yes]

label: Waist Circumference
definition: The distance around an individual's midsection or waist.

label: Body Mass Index
definition: A general indicator of the body fat an individual is carrying based upon the ratio of weight to height. (NCI)

label: Weight
definition: The vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity. (NCI)

label: Systolic Blood Pressure
definition: The maximum blood pressure in the systemic arterial circulation during the cardiac cycle.

label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
definition: The minimum blood pressure in the systemic arterial circulation during the cardiac cycle.

label: Height
definition: The vertical measurement or distance from the base to the top of an object; the vertical dimension of extension. (NCI)

label: Pulse Rate
definition: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot. (NCI)

label: Frequency
definition: The terminology that includes terms pertaining to frequency within CDISC. [extensible=Yes]

label: Daily
definition: A rate of occurrences within a period of time equal to one day.

label: Twice Daily
definition: Two times per day, at unspecified times. (NCI)

label: As Needed
definition: As needed. (NCI)

label: Once Weekly
definition: One time per week. (NCI)

label: Position
definition: Terminology codelist used with Body Position within CDISC. [extensible=Yes]

label: Lateral Decubitus Position
definition: Lying down on one side.

label: Semi-Recumbent
definition: A semi-sitting or semi-reclined body position in which the head is elevated above horizontal. (NCI)

label: Sitting With Legs Dependent
definition: A position where the legs of a subject dangle, or hang down, while sitting.

label: Standing, Bent Forward
definition: A position where the subject is standing and bent forward at the waist.

label: Sitting
definition: The state or act of one who sits; the posture of one who occupies a seat. (NCI)

label: Prone Position
definition: An anterior recumbent body position whereby the person lies on its stomach and faces downward. (NCI)

label: Standing
definition: The act of assuming or maintaining an erect upright position. (NCI)

label: Supine Position
definition: A posterior recumbent body position whereby the person lies on its back and faces upward. (NCI)

label: Trendelenburg
definition: A supine position with the person inclined at an angle of 45 degrees so that the pelvis is higher than the head. (NCI)

label: Reverse Trendelenburg
definition: A supine position with the person inclined at an angle of 45 degrees so that the head is higher than the pelvis. (NCI)

label: Right Lateral Decubitus Position
definition: A recumbent right lateral side position. (NCI)

label: Left Lateral Decubitus Position
definition: A recumbent left lateral side position. (NCI)

label: Fowler's Position
definition: A semi-sitting position whereby the head of an adjustable bed is elevated to the desired height, about 60-90 cm, to produce angulation of the body, usually 45 degrees to 60 degrees. Knees may or may not be bent. (NCI)

label: Semi-Fowler's Position
definition: A semi-sitting or semi-reclined body position whereby the head is elevated on an angle of approximately 30 degrees. (NCI)

label: Recumbent Position
definition: Lying down. (NCI)

label: Unconstrained Body Movement
definition: The ability to move body parts and limbs without physical restriction. (NCI)

label: Patient in Body Sling
definition: A position in which the subject's body is supported by a sling.

label: Epoch
definition: The name of the EPOCH. [extensible=Yes]

label: Treatment Epoch
definition: A period in a study during which subjects are receiving investigational therapy or treatment.

label: Blinded Treatment Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects receive blinded therapeutic treatment.

label: Open Label Treatment Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects receive open label therapeutic treatment.

label: Continuation Therapy Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects receive continuation treatment.

label: Induction Therapy Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects receive induction treatment.

label: Baseline Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study after eligibility has been met and before the start of treatment, at which baseline measurements are collected.

label: Observation Study Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects are observed, without any planned intervention.

label: Pre-Screening Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects are evaluated prior to entering the full screening period.

label: Screening Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects are evaluated for participation in the study.

label: Long-term Follow-up Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which information about the health status of an individual is obtained long after study interventions have concluded.

label: Follow-Up Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which information about the health status of an individual is obtained after study interventions have concluded.

label: Investigational Intervention Epoch
definition: A period in a study during which subjects are receiving investigational intervention(s).

label: Product Exposure Epoch
definition: A period in a clinical study during which subjects are exposed to the product.

label: Washout Period
definition: The interval of time that a participant enrolled in a study must not receive a specified treatment(s) before starting a study intervention(s). (CDISC Glossary)

label: Run-in Period
definition: A period in a clinical study that occurs after screening and before randomization, during which the subject is further evaluated and/or prepared for the commencement of the clinical study investigation.

label: Waist Circumference
definition: A circumferential measurement of the waist, which may be classified as the area immediately below the lowest rib, at the narrowest part of the torso, midpoint between the lowest rib and the iliac crest, or immediately above the iliac crest.

label: Body Mass Index
definition: An individual's weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height in meters.

label: Body Height
definition: The vertical measurement or distance from the base to the top of a subject or participant.

label: Weight
definition: The vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity.

label: Systolic Blood Pressure
definition: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.

label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
definition: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling.

label: Height
definition: The vertical measurement or distance from the base to the top of an object; the vertical dimension of extension.

label: Vital Signs Measurement
definition: The act of assessing an individual's current temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, pulse oxygenation, and blood pressure.

label: Pulse Rate
definition: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomic sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.

label: Blood Pressure
definition: The pressure of the circulating blood against the walls of the blood vessels.

label: Body Weight
definition: The weight of a subject.

disease
definition: A disease is a disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

label: lower respiratory tract disorder
definition: A disease involving the lower respiratory tract.

label: respiratory system cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the respiratory system

label: digestive system neuroendocrine tumor, grade 1/2
definition: A well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor arising from the digestive system. It is characterized by the presence of cells with features similar to those of the normal endocrine cells of the digestive system. The neoplastic cells express immunohistochemical evidence of neuroendocrine differentiation and hormones. There is mild to moderate nuclear atypia and less than 20 mitoses per 10 HPF. It includes well-differentiated endocrine tumors or carcinoid tumors and well-differentiated endocrine carcinomas.

label: small cell carcinoma
definition: A neuroendocrine carcinoma composed of small malignant cells which are often said to resemble \"oat cells\" under the microscope. Small cell carcinoma most often affects the lungs. Clinically, this is often a rapidly growing cancer that spreads to distant sites early.

label: anal canal cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the anal canal

label: X-linked disease
definition: X-linked form of disease.

label: autosomal dominant disease
definition: Autosomal dominant form of disease.

label: autosomal genetic disease
definition: A monogenic disease that is has material basis in a mutation in a single gene on one of the non-sex chromosomes.

label: paraganglioma
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from paraganglia located along the sympathetic or parasympathetic nerves. Infrequently, it may arise outside the usual distribution of the sympathetic and parasympathetic paraganglia. Tumors arising from the adrenal gland medulla are called pheochromocytomas. Morphologically, paragangliomas usually display a nesting (Zellballen) growth pattern. There are no reliable morphologic criteria to distinguish between benign and malignant paragangliomas. The only definitive indicator of malignancy is the presence of regional or distant metastases.

label: arterial disorder
definition: An impairment of the structure or function of the blood vessels which carry blood away from the heart.

label: salivary gland carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from the major or minor salivary glands. Representative examples include carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma, adenocarcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma, and mucoepidermoid carcinoma.

label: lung combined type small cell adenocarcinoma
definition: A lung combined type small cell carcinoma that has material basis in epithelial tissue of glandular origin.

label: autoimmune disorder of endocrine system
definition: A hypersensitivity reaction type II disease that involves the endocrine system.

label: autoimmune disorder of gastrointestinal tract
definition: A hypersensitivity reaction type II disease that involves the alimentary part of gastrointestinal system.

label: hypersensitivity reaction disease
definition: An immune system disease that has basis in dysregulation of the hypersensitivity reaction, an inflammatory response to an exogenous environmental antigen or an endogenous antigen initiated by the adaptive immune system.

label: immune system cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the immune system

label: integumentary system cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the integumental system

label: bipolar II disorder
definition: A bipolar disorder that is characterized by at least one hypomanic episode and at least one major depressive episode; with this disorder, depressive episodes are more frequent and more intense than manic episodes.

label: seasonal affective disorder
definition: A syndrome characterized by depressions that recur annually at the same time each year, usually during the winter months. Other symptoms include anxiety, irritability, decreased energy, increased appetite (carbohydrate cravings), increased duration of sleep, and weight gain. sad (seasonal affective disorder) can be treated by daily exposure to bright artificial lights (phototherapy), during the season of recurrence.

label: syndrome caused by partial chromosomal deletion
definition: A chromosomal disorder consisting of the absence of a part of a chromosome.

label: allergic respiratory disease
definition: A respiratory system disease with a basis in a pathological type I hypersensitivity reaction.

label: drug allergy
definition: Immunologically mediated adverse reactions to medicinal substances used legally or illegally.

label: anomalous left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
definition: A congenital coronary vessel anomaly in which the left main coronary artery originates from the pulmonary artery instead of from aorta. The congenital heart defect typically results in coronary artery fistula; left-sided heart failure and mitral valve insufficiency during the first months of life.

label: thrombotic disease
definition: The formation of a blood clot in the lumen of a vessel or heart chamber; causes include coagulation disorders and vascular endothelial injury.

label: ampulla of vater cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the ampulla of Vater.

label: duodenum cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the duodenum. Representative examples include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

label: ampulla of vater neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm involving the ampulla of Vater.

label: endometrial disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the endometrium. Representative examples include endometritis, endometrial hyperplasia, and endometrial carcinoma.

label: small intestine cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the small intestine.

label: heart conduction disease
definition: A disease that has its basis in the disruption of the heart's electrical conduction system.

label: gastric cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the stomach.

label: mild pre-eclampsia
definition: A pre-eclampsia characterized by the presence of hypertension without evidence of end-organ damage, in a woman who was normotensive before 20 weeks' gestation.

label: renal hypertension
definition: Hypertension caused by the kidney's hormonal response to narrowing or occlusion of the renal arteries.

label: kidney failure
definition: An acute or chronic condition that is characterized by the inability of the kidneys to adequately filter the blood.

label: chronic pyelonephritis
definition: Persistent pyelonephritis.

label: malignant essential hypertension
definition: Essential hypertension with rapid progression to severe high blood pressure, papilledema, and renal failure.

label: essential hypertension
definition: Hypertension that presents without an identifiable cause.

label: salivary gland disorder
definition: A disease involving the saliva-secreting gland.

label: benign essential hypertension
definition: A condition of mild to moderate high blood pressure that has no identifiable cause.

label: nephritis
definition: Inflammation of renal tissue.

label: chronic rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis
definition: Chronic form of rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis.

label: urinary bladder cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the bladder.

label: secondary hypertension
definition: High blood pressure caused by an underlying medical condition.

label: appendix cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the vermiform appendix

label: appendiceal neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm involving the appendix.

label: autonomic nervous system disorder
definition: A disease involving the autonomic nervous system.

label: hypertensive heart disease
definition: Abnormal enlargement of the heart resulting from long-standing hypertension.

label: familial hyperlipidemia
definition: An instance of hyperlipidemia (disease) that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

label: bronchial disorder
definition: A disease involving the bronchus.

label: myopia
definition: The condition in which the individual does not see far distances clearly.

label: peripheral nervous system neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from a peripheral nerve or the perineural sheaths.

label: female reproductive organ cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the female reproductive system. Representative examples include endometrial carcinoma, cervical carcinoma, ovarian carcinoma, uterine corpus leiomyosarcoma, adenosarcoma, malignant mixed mesodermal (mullerian) tumor, and gestational choriocarcinoma.

label: paranoid schizophrenia
definition: A subtype of schizophrenia characterized by prominent delusions (typically persecutory or grandiose) or hallucinations in the context of a relative preservation of cognitive functioning and affect.

label: cough variant asthma
definition: An asthma that is characterized by chronic nonproductive cough without shortness of breath.

label: chronic pulmonary heart disease
definition: Heart disease which occurs as a result of a primary pulmonary disease. Cor pulmonale most often manifests as right ventricular hypertrophy; it can also lead to right ventricular failure.

label: retroperitoneum carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the retroperitoneal space.

label: vulva cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the vulva.

label: rectal disorder
definition: A disease that involves the rectum.

label: dementia
definition: Loss of intellectual abilities interfering with an individual's social and occupational functions. Causes include Alzheimer's disease, brain injuries, brain tumors, and vascular disorders.

label: vertebral artery insufficiency
definition: A syndrome which occurs as a result of the occlusion of one of the vertebral arteries. It may be caused by atherosclerosis, embolism or hemorrhage. Collateral circulation through the circle of Willis is usually comprised as well. Clinical signs may include vertigo, nystagmus, dysarthria, ataxia and sensorimotor deficits. Clinical course may lead to persistence of neurologic deficits. Prognosis is variable with a substantial risk for recurrent infarction.

label: severe pre-eclampsia
definition: Preeclampsia with a systolic blood pressure of 160 mmHg or higher, or a diastolic blood pressure of 110 mmHg or higher on two occasions at least 4 hours apart while on bedrest. It is associated with thrombocytopenia (platelets less than 100,000 per microliter), impaired liver function (twice normal elevation of hepatic transaminases; severe, persistent right upper quadrant or epigastric pain), progressive renal insufficiency (serum creatinine greater than 1.1 mg/dL or doubling of baseline in the absence of other renal disease), pulmonary edema, or new-onset cerebral or visual disturbances.

label: benign secondary hypertension
definition: Mild to moderate high blood pressure that is caused by an underlying medical condition.

label: proliferative diabetic retinopathy
definition: Advanced retinopathy due to diabetes mellitus characterized by the formation of new vessels in the retina. The new vessels are abnormal and fragile. If hemorrhage occurs due to the vascular fragility, there is increased risk of vision loss or blindness.

label: background diabetic retinopathy
definition: An early stage of diabetic retinopathy that is characterized by retinal hemorrhage and exudate, but without proliferation of the blood vessels.

label: eclampsia
definition: A potentially life-threatening pregnancy-related disorder characterized by tonic-clonic seizures in association with hypertension after the twentieth week of gestation and up to six weeks postpartum and in the absence of other potential causes of seizures.

label: bipolar I disorder
definition: A bipolar disorder that is characterized by at least one manic or mixed episode.

label: anus cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the anus

label: ureteral disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder affecting the ureter.

label: endocrine pancreas disorder
definition: A disease involving the endocrine pancreas.

label: idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension
definition: A sporadic form of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) characterized by elevated pulmonary arterial resistance leading to right heart failure. IPAH is progressive and potentially fatal and not associated with an underlying condition or family history of PAH. The etiology is unknown.

label: major depressive disorder
definition: An episode of depression lasting two or more weeks without an intervening episode of mania.

label: disorder of orbital region
definition: A disease that involves the orbital region.

label: psychiatric disorder
definition: A disorder characterized by behavioral and/or psychological abnormalities, often accompanied by physical symptoms. The symptoms may cause clinically significant distress or impairment in social and occupational areas of functioning. Representative examples include anxiety disorders, cognitive disorders, mood disorders and schizophrenia.

label: cecal disorder
definition: Pathological developments in the cecum.

label: colon carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the colon

label: cecum cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the caecum

label: head and neck carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from the head and neck region. Representative examples include oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma, laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma, and salivary gland carcinoma.

label: cognitive disorder
definition: A disease affects cognitive processes.

label: depressive disorder
definition: A melancholy feeling of sadness and despair.

label: integumentary system disorder
definition: A disease involving the integumental system.

label: musculoskeletal system disorder
definition: A disease involving the musculoskeletal system.

label: endocrine gland neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the epithelial cells of an endocrine organ. Representative examples include pituitary gland adenoma, pituitary gland carcinoma, thyroid gland carcinoma, carcinoid tumor, and neuroendocrine carcinoma.

label: thyroid cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the thyroid gland

label: malignant exocrine pancreas neoplasm
definition: A malignant neoplasm that arises from the epithelial cells of the exocrine pancreatic tissue.

label: urinary system disorder
definition: A disease involving the renal system.

label: neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A malignant neuroendocrine neoplasm composed of cells containing secretory granules that stain positive for NSE and chromogranin. The neoplastic cells are often round and form clusters or trabecular sheets. Representative examples are small cell carcinoma, large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, and Merkel cell carcinoma.

label: hypogonadism
definition: A disorder characterized by decreased function of the gonads. Clinical manifestations in both males and females include poor libido, infertility, and osteoporosis. Additional signs in males include erectile dysfunction, muscle atrophy, gynecomastia and increased abdominal fat. In females, additional signs include shrinking of the breasts and loss of, or failure to develop menstruation.

label: reproductive system cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the reproductive organ

label: rectal neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the rectum. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include lipoma and leiomyoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma. Rectal adenomas always exhibit epithelial dysplasia and are considered premalignant neoplasms.

label: vulvar disease
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the vulva. Representative examples include infection, Bartholin gland adenoma, and vulvar carcinoma.

label: ovarian epithelial tumor
definition: A benign, borderline, or malignant tumor that originates from the surface epithelium of the ovary. It is composed of epithelial cells and stroma. Representative examples of benign tumors include serous cystadenoma, mucinous cystadenoma, and benign Brenner tumor. Representative examples of borderline tumors include serous surface papillary tumor, mucinous adenofibroma, and borderline Brenner tumor. Representative examples of malignant tumors include serous adenocarcinoma, mucinous adenocarcinoma, endometrioid adenocarcinoma, and malignant Brenner tumor.

label: hepatitis
definition: An active inflammatory process affecting the liver for more than six months. Causes include viral infections, autoimmune disorders, drugs, and metabolic disorders.

label: syndromic disease
definition: A group of signs, symptoms, and clinicopathological characteristics that may or may not have a genetic basis and collectively define an abnormal condition.

label: cervix disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the cervix. Representative examples include cervicitis, endocervical polyp, and carcinoma.

label: gonadal disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the testis or the ovary.

label: female reproductive system disorder
definition: A disease involving the female reproductive system.

label: arteriosclerosis disorder
definition: A vascular disorder characterized by thickening and hardening of the walls of the arteries.

label: dermis tumor
definition: A benign, intermediate, or malignant neoplasm that arises from the dermis.

label: retinal vascular disorder
definition: Retinal damage resulting from diminished blood flow/oxygenation due to abnormalities of the retinal vessels. Causes include hypertension, diabetes, thrombosis, embolism, and hemorrhage.

label: hematopoietic and lymphoid system neoplasm
definition: Neoplasms of the hematopoietic system, including hematopoietic cell neoplasms (e.g. leukemias, lymphomas) and non-hematopoietic cell neoplasms that can affect the hematopoietic system (e.g. lymph node and splenic sarcomas). --2003

label: larynx cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the larynx. The majority are carcinomas.

label: pancreas disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the pancreas. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include pancreatitis and pancreatic insufficiency. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include cystadenomas, carcinomas, lymphomas, and neuroendocrine neoplasms.

label: laryngeal carcinoma
definition: Carcinoma that arises from the laryngeal epithelium. More than 90% of laryngeal carcinomas are squamous cell carcinomas. The remainder are adenoid cystic carcinomas, mucoepidermoid carcinomas and carcinomas with neuroendocrine differentiation.

label: autonomic nervous system neoplasm
definition: Benign and malignant neoplasms which arise from or directly involve the central or peripheral elements of the autonomic nervous system.

label: long QT syndrome
definition: A cardiac rhythm disease characterized by prolongation of the corrected QT (QTc) interval on the surface electrocardiogram, associated with precipitation of torsade de pointes (TdP), a polymorphic ventricular tachycardia that may cause sudden death. It is characterized by episodes of fainting (syncope) and varying degree of ventricular arrhythmia. It may be congenital or, more frequently, acquired. The inherited forms are caused by mutation of genes encoding cardiac ion channel proteins.

label: melancholia
definition: A subtype of depression characterized by the inability to find pleasure in positive things combined with physical agitation, insomnia, or decreased appetite.

label: endometrial carcinoma
definition: A malignant tumor arising from the epithelium that lines the cavity of the uterine body. The vast majority of endometrial carcinomas are adenocarcinomas; squamous cell and adenosquamous carcinomas represent a minority of the cases. Endometrioid adenocarcinoma is the most frequently seen variant of endometrial adenocarcinoma. Uterine bleeding is an initial clinical sign. The prognosis depends on the stage of the tumor, the depth of myometrial wall invasion, and the degree of differentiation.

label: glomerulonephritis
definition: A renal disorder characterized by damage in the glomeruli. It may be acute or chronic, focal or diffuse, and it may lead to renal failure. Causes include autoimmune disorders, infections, diabetes, and malignancies.

label: prostate neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the prostate gland. This category includes carcinoid tumors and small cell carcinomas.

label: ovarian neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: An epithelial neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the ovary. It includes carcinoid tumor, small cell carcinoma pulmonary type, and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma.

label: breast neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm that arises from the breast and is composed of cells of neuroendocrine origin. Most cases are neuroendocrine carcinomas. Primary carcinoid tumors of the breast are very rare.

label: substance-related disorder
definition: A category of psychiatric disorders which include disorders related to the taking of a drug of abuse (including alcohol, prescribed medications and recreational drugs).

label: hepatobiliary neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the liver parenchyma, bile ducts, and gallbladder. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include hepatocellular adenoma, bile duct adenoma, and gallbladder lipoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic and extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and gallbladder carcinoma.

label: hepatobiliary disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the liver, bile ducts, and gallbladder. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include hepatitis, cirrhosis, cholangitis, and cholecystitis. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include hepatocellular adenoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and cholangiocarcinoma.

label: digestive system cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving any part of the digestive system.

label: anus disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the anal canal or anal margin. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include hemorrhoids and anal ulcer. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include carcinoma, lymphoma, and melanoma.

label: inherited lipid metabolism disorder
definition: An inherited metabolic disorder caused by an enzyme deficiency, resulting in an inability to oxidize fatty acids for energy production.

label: skin neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant tumor involving the skin. Representative examples of benign skin neoplasms include the benign melanocytic skin nevus, acanthoma, sebaceous adenoma, sweat gland adenoma, lipoma, hemangioma, fibroma, and benign fibrous histiocytoma. Representative examples of malignant skin neoplasms include basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, melanoma, and Kaposi sarcoma.

label: thymus cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the thymus. This category includes malignant thymomas, thymic lymphomas, primary thymic carcinomas, and metastatic carcinomas from other anatomic sites.

label: central nervous system disorder
definition: A disease involving the central nervous system.

label: bone inflammation disease
definition: Inflammation of the bone.

label: uterine disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the uterine corpus or the cervix. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include endometritis and cervicitis. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include endometrial carcinoma, carcinosarcoma, and cervical carcinoma.

label: skin carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the zone of skin

label: breast disorder
definition: A disease involving the breast.

label: extrahepatic bile duct adenocarcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the extrahepatic bile duct

label: cerebral infarction
definition: An ischemic condition of the brain, producing a persistent focal neurological deficit in the area of distribution of the cerebral arteries.

label: liver cancer
definition: An epithelial or non-epithelial malignant neoplasm that arises from the liver. Representative examples include hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

label: central nervous system cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the central nervous system

label: uterine cancer
definition: Primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the uterine corpus and/or the cervix.

label: adrenal gland cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the adrenal gland

label: bartholin gland carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from the Bartholin gland. It usually affects women over fifty and presents with enlargement of the Bartholin gland. Various histologic subtypes have been identified and include adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, transitional cell carcinoma, and small cell carcinoma.

label: duodenal disorder
definition: Pathological conditions in the duodenum region of the small intestine (intestine, small).

label: colon neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the colon. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

label: intestinal neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the small or large intestine. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

label: common bile duct disorder
definition: A disease involving the common bile duct.

label: bile duct disorder
definition: A disease involving the bile duct.

label: skin cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the zone of skin

label: glucose metabolism disease
definition: A metabolic disorder characterized by abnormal blood glucose levels.

label: cervical cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the cervix.

label: anus neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the anal canal or anal margin. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include squamous papilloma and papillary hidradenoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, lymphoma, and melanoma.

label: thymic large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: An aggressive, non-small cell, poorly differentiated thymic neuroendocrine carcinoma, characterized by the presence of a high mitotic rate and, almost always, necrosis.

label: ovarian large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells exhibiting neuroendocrine differentiation. The prognosis is poor.

label: lung large cell carcinoma
definition: A poorly differentiated non-small cell lung carcinoma composed of large polygonal cells without evidence of glandular or squamous differentiation. There is a male predilection.

label: bile duct cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the bile duct

label: biliary tract cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the biliary tree

label: extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the extrahepatic bile duct.

label: prostate disorder
definition: A disease involving the prostate gland.

label: gastric neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the stomach. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

label: male reproductive system disorder
definition: A disease involving the male reproductive system.

label: bile duct adenocarcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the bile duct

label: appendix carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the vermiform appendix

label: anal carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the anus

label: gallbladder carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the gall bladder

label: alcoholic pancreatitis
definition: Acute or chronic inflammation of the pancreas due to excessive alcohol drinking. Alcoholic pancreatitis usually presents as an acute episode but it is a chronic progressive disease in alcoholics.

label: thyroid gland disorder
definition: A disease involving the thyroid gland.

label: thoracic cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm affecting the tissues of the thorax.

label: malignant dermis tumor
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the dermis.

label: thymus gland disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the thymus. Representative examples include thymic hyperplasia, thymoma, and thymic carcinoma.

label: sleep-wake disorder
definition: Abnormal sleep-wake schedule or pattern associated with the circadian rhythm which affect the length, timing, and/or rigidity of the sleep-wake cycle relative to the day-night cycle. These can include dyssomnias such as circadian rhythm disorders, hypersomnia, and sleep apnea and parasomnias such as bruxism and rapid eye movement sleep disorder.

label: colonic disorder
definition: Pathological processes in the colon region of the large intestine (intestine, large).

label: occult small cell lung carcinoma
definition: A small cell lung carcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. The primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

label: combined small cell lung carcinoma
definition: A morphologic variant of small cell lung carcinoma in combination with a non-small cell carcinoma.

label: anal canal neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the anal canal. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

label: adrenal medulla cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the adrenal medulla

label: peripheral nervous system disorder
definition: A disease involving the peripheral nervous system.

label: rectum neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the rectum. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

label: esophageal neuroendocrine tumor
definition: A well differentiated, low or intermediate grade tumor with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the esophagus.

label: extrahepatic bile duct small cell adenocarcinoma
definition: An aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. It is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.

label: esophageal disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the esophagus. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include esophagitis and esophageal ulcer. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include carcinomas, lymphomas, and melanomas.

label: ovarian small cell carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of small malignant cells. It includes small cell carcinoma, hypercalcemic type and small cell carcinoma, pulmonary type.

label: hereditary disease
definition: A disease that is caused by genetic modifications where those modifications are inherited from a parent's genome.

label: overnutrition
definition: An imbalanced nutritional status resulting from excessive intake of nutrients. Generally, overnutrition generates an energy imbalance between food consumption and energy expenditure leading to disorders such as obesity.

label: muscle tissue disorder
definition: A disease involving the muscle tissue.

label: breast large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the breast. It is characterized by the presence of large neuroendocrine cells and high mitotic activity.

label: pulmonary large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma that involves the lung(s).

label: colon small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: An aggressive, high-grade, and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the colon. It is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.

label: inborn mitochondrial metabolism disorder
definition: Diseases caused by abnormal function of the mitochondria. They may be caused by mutations, acquired or inherited, in mitochondrial dna or in nuclear genes that code for mitochondrial components. They may also be the result of acquired mitochondria dysfunction due to adverse effects of drugs, infections, or other environmental causes.

label: urinary bladder small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A highly aggressive carcinoma, histologically resembling small cell lung carcinoma. In most cases it is associated with carcinoma in situ.

label: esophageal small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: An aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the esophagus. It is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.

label: ampulla of vater small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: An aggressive neuroendocrine carcinoma arising from the ampulla of Vater and the periampullary region. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of small malignant cells, necrosis, and a high mitotic rate. Signs and symptoms include jaundice, abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.

label: Bartholin gland small cell carcinoma
definition: A rare neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the Bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells and high mitotic activity.

label: thymus small cell carcinoma
definition: An aggressive, small cell, poorly differentiated thymic neuroendocrine carcinoma, characterized by the presence of a high mitotic rate and numerous apoptotic bodies.

label: lung combined large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A subtype of large cell neuroendocrine lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of large neuroendocrine cells in combination with adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, giant cell carcinoma and/ or spindle cell carcinoma.

label: adrenal medulla carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the adrenal medulla

label: small intestine neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the small intestine. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include lipoma and leiomyoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

label: stomach disorder
definition: A disease involving the stomach.

label: pulmonary type ovarian small cell carcinoma
definition: An aggressive small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the ovary. Morphologically, it resembles the small cell carcinoma that arises from the lung.

label: hypercalcemic type ovarian small cell carcinoma
definition: An undifferentiated small cell carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is associated with hypercalcemia. Electron microscopic studies show neurosecretory granules are either absent or, when present, are in small numbers.

label: digestive system disorder
definition: A disease or disorder that involves the digestive system.

label: renal infectious disease
definition: An infectious disease that involves the kidney.

label: end stage renal failure
definition: Long-standing and persistent renal disease with glomerular filtration rate (GFR) less than 15 ml/min.

label: laryngeal disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the larynx. Representative examples include laryngitis, vocal cord polyp, squamous papilloma, and carcinoma.

label: cor pulmonale
definition: Hypertrophy and dilation of the right ventricle of the heart that is caused by pulmonary hypertension. This condition is often associated with pulmonary parenchymal or vascular diseases, such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and pulmonary embolism.

label: acute cor pulmonale
definition: A form of acute right heart failure produced by a sudden increase in resistance to blood flow in the pulmonary circulation.

label: vascular dementia
definition: A degenerative vascular disorder affecting the brain. It is caused by the blockage of the blood supply to the brain. It is manifested with decline of memory and cognitive functions.

label: salivary gland cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the major or minor salivary glands. Representative examples include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

label: central sleep apnea syndrome
definition: A broad classification of disorders which includes 6 subtypes (primary central sleep apnea, central sleep apnea due to Cheyne-Stokes breathing pattern, central sleep apnea due to medical condition not Cheyne-Stokes, central sleep apnea due to high-altitude periodic breathing, central sleep apnea due to drug or substance and primary sleep apnea of infancy) that are each characterized by interruptions in breathing while asleep. It is caused by improper signaling from the brainstem to respiratory muscles and is triggered by either hypoventilation or hyperventilation. In adults, this disorder may

label: intrinsic asthma
definition: An asthma that is triggered by factors not related to allergies such as anxiety, stress, exercise, cold air, dry air, hyperventilation, smoke, viruses, chemical irritants, autonomic imbalance, hormonal deficiencies and psychogenic influences. It is characterized by airway obstruction and inflammation that is at least partially reversible with medication. The symptoms include coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath or rapid breathing, and chest tightness.

label: status asthmaticus
definition: An acute exacerbation of asthma, characterized by inadequate response to initial bronchodilators.

label: allergic asthma
definition: A asthma with a basis in a pathological type I hypersensitivity reaction.

label: fatty liver disease
definition: A reversible condition wherein large vacuoles of triglyceride fat accumulate in liver cells via the process of steatosis.

label: upper respiratory tract disorder
definition: A disease involving the upper respiratory tract.

label: biliary tract disorder
definition: A disease involving the biliary tree.

label: refractive error
definition: A defect in the focusing of light on the retina as in astigmatism, myopia, or hyperopia.

label: gastric carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the stomach.

label: adenocarcinoma
definition: A common cancer characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells. Morphologically, adenocarcinomas are classified according to the growth pattern (e.g., papillary, alveolar) or according to the secreting product (e.g., mucinous, serous). Representative examples of adenocarcinoma are ductal and lobular breast carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma (hepatoma), colon adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.

label: adrenal gland pheochromocytoma
definition: A benign or malignant neuroendocrine neoplasm of the sympathetic nervous system that secretes catecholamines. It arises from the chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla. Clinical presentation includes headaches, palpitations, chest and abdominal pain, hypertension, fever, and tremor. Microscopically, a characteristic nesting (zellballen) growth pattern is usually seen. Other growth patterns including trabecular pattern may also be present.

label: asthma
definition: A bronchial disease that is characterized by chronic inflammation and narrowing of the airways, which is caused by a combination of environmental and genetic factors resulting in recurring periods of wheezing (a whistling sound while breathing), chest tightness, shortness of breath, mucus production and coughing. The symptoms appear due to a variety of triggers such as allergens, irritants, respiratory infections, weather changes, exercise, stress, reflux disease, medications, foods and emotional anxiety.

label: atrial fibrillation
definition: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of a supraventricular arrhythmia characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape and timing and are accompanied by an irregular ventricular response. (CDISC)

label: pancreatitis
definition: Inflammation of the pancreas.

label: bipolar disorder
definition: A disorder of the brain that causes unusual shifts in mood, energy, activity levels and the ability to carry out day-to-day tasks. Often these moods range and shift from periods of elation and energized behavior to those of hopelessness and depression.

label: urinary bladder carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the urinary bladder

label: urinary bladder neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant, primary or metastatic neoplasm of the bladder. - 2003

label: breast carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the breast

label: cancer
definition: A tumor composed of atypical neoplastic, often pleomorphic cells that invade other tissues. Malignant neoplasms often metastasize to distant anatomic sites and may recur after excision. The most common malignant neoplasms are carcinomas (adenocarcinomas or squamous cell carcinomas), Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphomas, leukemias, melanomas, and sarcomas.

label: carcinoma
definition: A malignant tumor arising from epithelial cells. Carcinomas that arise from glandular epithelium are called adenocarcinomas, those that arise from squamous epithelium are called squamous cell carcinomas, and those that arise from transitional epithelium are called transitional cell carcinomas. Morphologically, the malignant epithelial cells may display abnormal mitotic figures, anaplasia, and necrosis. Carcinomas are graded by the degree of cellular differentiation as well, moderately, or poorly differentiated. Carcinomas invade the surrounding tissues and tend to metastasize to other anatomic

label: cardiovascular disorder
definition: A disease involving the cardiovascular system.

label: chronic pancreatitis
definition: A chronic inflammatory process causing damage and fibrosis of the pancreatic parenchyma. Signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, malabsorption and diabetes mellitus.

label: congestive heart failure
definition: Failure of the heart to pump a sufficient amount of blood to meet the needs of the body tissues, resulting in tissue congestion and edema. Signs and symptoms include shortness of breath, pitting edema, enlarged tender liver, engorged neck veins, and pulmonary rales.

label: coronary artery disorder
definition: Narrowing of the coronary arteries due to fatty deposits inside the arterial walls. The diagnostic criteria may include documented history of any of the following: documented coronary artery stenosis greater than or equal to 50% (by cardiac catheterization or other modality of direct imaging of the coronary arteries); previous coronary artery bypass surgery (CABG); previous percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI); previous myocardial infarction. (ACC)

label: diabetes mellitus
definition: A metabolic disorder characterized by abnormally high blood sugar levels due to diminished production of insulin or insulin resistance/desensitization.

label: diabetic kidney disease
definition: Progressive kidney disorder caused by vascular damage to the glomerular capillaries, in patients with diabetes mellitus. It is usually manifested with nephritic syndrome and glomerulosclerosis.

label: intestinal disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the small or large intestine.

label: thyroid gland follicular carcinoma
definition: A differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland. The nuclear features which characterize the thyroid gland papillary carcinoma are absent. Radiation exposure is a risk factor and it comprises approximately 10% to 15% of thyroid cancers. Clinically, it usually presents as a solitary mass in the thyroid gland. It is generally unifocal and thickly encapsulated and shows invasion of the capsule or the vessels. Diagnostic procedures include thyroid ultrasound and fine needle biopsy.

label: reproductive system disorder
definition: A disease involving the reproductive system.

label: hypertensive disorder
definition: Persistently high systemic arterial blood pressure. Based on multiple readings (blood pressure determination), hypertension is currently defined as when systolic pressure is consistently greater than 140 mm Hg or when diastolic pressure is consistently 90 mm Hg or more.

label: immune system disorder
definition: A disorder resulting from an abnormality in the immune system.

label: ischemic disease
definition: Lack of blood supply to an area of the body, resulting in impairment of tissue oxygenation.

label: large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A usually aggressive carcinoma composed of large malignant cells which display neuroendocrine characteristics. It is characterized by the presence of high mitotic activity and necrotic changes. The vast majority of cases are positive for neuron-specific enolase. Representative examples include lung, breast, cervical, and thymic neuroendocrine carcinomas.

label: lung adenocarcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from the lung and is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells. There is a male predilection with a male to female ratio of 2:1. Usually lung adenocarcinoma is asymptomatic and is identified through screening studies or as an incidental radiologic finding. If clinical symptoms are present they include shortness of breath, cough, hemoptysis, chest pain, and fever. Tobacco smoke is a known risk factor.

label: metabolic disease
definition: A congenital disorder (due to inherited enzyme abnormality) or acquired (due to failure of a metabolically important organ) disorder resulting from an abnormal metabolic process.

label: neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant tissue growth resulting from uncontrolled cell proliferation. Benign neoplastic cells resemble normal cells without exhibiting significant cytologic atypia, while malignant cells exhibit overt signs such as dysplastic features, atypical mitotic figures, necrosis, nuclear pleomorphism, and anaplasia. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include papillomas, cystadenomas, and lipomas; malignant neoplasms include carcinomas, sarcomas, lymphomas, and leukemias.

label: nervous system disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the brain, spinal cord, or peripheral nerves.

label: preeclampsia
definition: Preeclampsia is a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy that is characterized by new-onset hypertension with proteinuria presenting after 20 weeks of gestation, and depending on mild or severe forms may initially present with severe headache, visual disturbances, and hyperreflexia.

label: mental disorder
definition: A disease that has its basis in the disruption of mental process.

label: respiratory system disorder
definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the respiratory system. Representative examples include pneumonia, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, pulmonary failure, lung adenoma, lung carcinoma, and tracheal carcinoma.

label: schizophrenia
definition: A major psychotic disorder characterized by abnormalities in the perception or expression of reality. It affects the cognitive and psychomotor functions. Common clinical signs and symptoms include delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, and retreat from reality.

label: skin disorder
definition: Any deviation from the normal structure or function of the skin or subcutaneous tissue that is manifested by a characteristic set of symptoms and signs.

label: stroke disorder
definition: A sudden loss of neurological function secondary to hemorrhage or ischemia in the brain parenchyma due to a vascular event.

label: subarachnoid hemorrhage
definition: A serious neurological disorder characterized by intracranial hemorrhage into the subarachnoid space.

label: bacterial infectious disease
definition: An acute infectious disorder that is caused by gram positive or gram negative bacteria; representative examples include pneumococcal, streptococcal, salmonella, and meningeal infections.

label: cervical carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma arising from either the exocervical squamous epithelium or the endocervical glandular epithelium. The major histologic types of cervical carcinoma are: squamous carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma and undifferentiated carcinoma.

label: nutritional disorder
definition: Any condition related to a disturbance between proper intake and utilization of nourishment.

label: lung carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the lung

label: morbid obesity
definition: An excess of body weight, normally defined as an individual with a body mass index greater than 35 or a body weight greater than one hundred percent of ideal body weight.

label: ovarian carcinoma
definition: A malignant neoplasm originating from the surface ovarian epithelium. It accounts for the greatest number of deaths from malignancies of the female genital tract and is the fifth leading cause of cancer fatalities in women. It is predominantly a disease of older white women of northern European extraction, but it is seen in all ages and ethnic groups. Adenocarcinomas constitute the vast majority of ovarian carcinomas. The pattern of metastatic spread in ovarian carcinoma is similar regardless of the microscopic type. The most common sites of involvement are the contralateral ovary, peritoneal

label: type 1 diabetes mellitus
definition: A chronic condition characterized by minimal or absent production of insulin by the pancreas.

label: type 2 diabetes mellitus
definition: A type of diabetes mellitus that is characterized by insulin resistance or desensitization and increased blood glucose levels. This is a chronic disease that can develop gradually over the life of a patient and can be linked to both environmental factors and heredity.

label: pulmonary hypertension
definition: Increased pressure within the pulmonary circulation due to lung or heart disorder.

label: endocrine system disorder
definition: A disease involving the endocrine system.

label: liver disorder
definition: A disease involving the liver.

label: prostate carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the prostate gland.

label: skeletal system disorder
definition: A disease involving the skeletal system.

label: osteoarthritis
definition: A noninflammatory degenerative joint disease occurring chiefly in older persons, characterized by degeneration of the articular cartilage, hypertrophy of bone at the margins and changes in the synovial membrane. It is accompanied by pain and stiffness, particularly after prolonged activity.

label: exocrine pancreatic carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the exocrine pancreas

label: thymus neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm that affects the thymus. Representative examples include thymoma and carcinoma.

label: uterine carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma involving a uterus.

label: vulvar carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the mammalian vulva

label: large cell carcinoma
definition: A malignant epithelial neoplasm composed of large, atypical cells.

label: non-small cell lung carcinoma
definition: A group of at least three distinct histological types of lung cancer, including non-small cell squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, and large cell carcinoma. Non-small cell lung carcinomas have a poor response to conventional chemotherapy.

label: kidney disorder
definition: A disease involving the kidney.

label: bacterial urinary tract infection
definition: A bacterial infectious process affecting any part of the urinary tract, most commonly the bladder and the urethra. Symptoms include urinary urgency and frequency, burning sensation during urination, lower abdominal discomfort, and cloudy urine.

label: heart failure
